findings.definitive_fix: Seal R2 SUPERSEDED in versioned ADR; Paso-4 wiring contains no d′-recompute-under-exclusion.
findings.closing_test: DONE(evidence-class corrected) — golden pins the HEAD-tracked DescriptiveScorer.kt (2 vectors: 1.310847010469/1.680015897775/1.292907666197 + non-monotonic flip). This is 2 golden vectors on a HEAD SUT, NOT an independent spec nor global parity. Remaining: ADR register R2=SUPERSEDED.

findings.title: R3 contract defines no missingness/MNAR policy for excludedFraction

findings.closing_test: missingness sensitivity analysis + bounds per tracer before any longitudinal comparison.

findings.title: Screen reader announces the correct answer → accuracy not modality-fair
findings.definitive_fix: Provisional: AT session = TRAINING_ONLY/UNMEASURED, not compared to visual norms. Design an auditory/haptic conflict task with separate estimand/norms. NOT just 'strip direction' (would make the task impossible).
findings.closing_test: Construct-preservation test (NOT a mere text-does-not-contain-left/right check); manual TalkBack + VoiceOver + Switch.
findings.residual_risk: Sequential presentation may itself change the construct.

findings.title: R3 authority chain UNTRACKED + manifest unanchored + truncated-hash origin

findings.closing_test: package_root_sha256 recorded in a signed commit message or immutable CI artifact.
findings.residual_risk: Self-contained manifest proves integrity-between-files, NOT authenticity.
